title: Train a 2-4-1 network on XOR
summary: Train a small sigmoid network with full-batch gradient descent until it labels noisy XOR points with 95 percent held-out accuracy.

mutants.lr_wrong_sign: Adds the gradient to the output weights instead of subtracting it, so the loss goes up.
mutants.zero_init: Starts every weight at zero, so all hidden units stay the same and the network cannot learn XOR.
mutants.missing_hidden_derivative: Forgets the sigmoid derivative h * (1 - h) when it sends the gradient back to the hidden layer.
mutants.over_budget: Trains for 3000 steps, more than the budget of 2000.
mutants.global_rng: Draws the first weights from np.random and not from the rng argument, so two runs with one seed differ.
mutants.centers_input_in_place: Centers X with X -= mean in place, so the caller's array changes.
